original: You are on your high horse about how you will not bow down to the Demon Lord、 and you completely deny the darkness in your heart。
contexto:
Dialogue. Adjacent lines in the same event:
A hypocrite!? What part about me is hypocritical!?
It is embarrassing to lose to your weakness? Pathetic、 even?
Yep! That is because there are those around me who have sworn to lend me a hand so I will not fall victim to the darkness in my heart!
Because of that、 there is no way I could look any of them in the face if I were to actually become the Demon Lord!
